parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Human-readable description of the {{object}}. For example, a more detailed description of {{param|Type}}.

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: Some {{object}} instances can provide a duration together with the latest state change. The duration is an indication of the time, measured in {{units}}, between the start of the state change and the end of the state change: i.e., returning to its original state. The original state can be a low state or high state.

parameters.name: Transition
parameters.description: Indicates the moment a pulse is generated. This can be a {{enum|RisingEdge}} transition: in case the sensor changes from low to high state. {{enum|FallingEdge}} transition: in case the sensor changes from high to low state.

object.description: {{object}} provides information to an actuator that sensor changed from one state to another state. In addition to the state change, the {{object}} can provide additional information about the type of transition via {{param|Transition}} and the pulse duration via {{param|Duration}}.
